title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Crimes of Sexual Assault against Minors
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Sexual Assault Crimes Against Minors

Case 1: Wang Jiajia — Forced Prostitution Case

(1) Basic Facts

The defendant Wang Jiajia, alias "Wang Jiang", male, Han ethnicity, born on August 28, 1986, with junior high school education, a farmer.

From June to October 2010, the defendant Wang Jiajia, in collusion with Zou Yu and Wang Mengyun (both co-defendants, already sentenced and convicted), conspired to force others into prostitution. They successively lured the victims Wang A (female, then aged 16, also a co-defendant), Zhou (female, then aged 18), Zhang (female, then aged 20), and Wang B (female, deceased at age 17) to Heyuan City, Guangdong Province, and forced the above victims into prostitution by means of beating, intimidation, forcing them to write IOUs, taking nude photos, etc. All proceeds from prostitution were controlled by Wang Jiajia and others. During this period, Wang B (aged 17) persistently refused to engage in prostitution and, when no one was watching, sent a text message to her family asking for help, which was discovered. Wang Jiajia and others beat Wang B with clothes hangers, rubber batons, belts and other tools, and abused Wang B by means of forced kneeling, pouring cold water, ordering her to balance a mineral water bottle on her head, etc. Wang A, at Wang Jiajia's request, participated in guarding Wang B. On November 2 of the same year, after beating Wang B, Wang Jiajia twice tied Wang B's hands with a belt and hung her from a beam in the bathroom. The next day, Wang B died from traumatic shock. During the period of forced prostitution, Wang Jiajia and others also confiscated the mobile phones of the four victims, robbed Zhang of 500 yuan in cash, and robbed the bank cards of Zhang and Wang B, withdrawing 8,400 yuan from Zhang's card and 1,300 yuan from Wang B's card.

(2) Judgment

The court held that the defendant Wang Jiajia, in collusion with others, used violence and threats to force the victims into prostitution, and his conduct constituted the crime of forced prostitution; Wang Jiajia, for the purpose of illegal possession, in collusion with others, used violence and coercion to rob the victims of property, and his conduct also constituted the crime of robbery, for which combined punishment should be imposed according to law. In the joint crime of forced prostitution, Wang Jiajia initiated the criminal intent, gathered multiple persons to participate, beat, abused, and controlled multiple victims, and was the principal offender. Wang Jiajia and others forced multiple persons to engage in prostitution multiple times, including two minor girls, causing one death; the circumstances of the crime were particularly vile, the methods particularly brutal, the offense extremely serious, and the social harm enormous, warranting severe punishment according to law. Accordingly, the defendant Wang Jiajia was found guilty of the crime of forced prostitution and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property; guilty of the crime of robbery and sentenced to seven years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 2,000; the combined sentence was death, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property. Upon review and approval by the Supreme People's Court, the criminal Wang Jiajia has been executed according to law.

Case 2: Yang Zongliang — Rape Case

(1) Basic Facts

Yang Zongliang, male, Han ethnicity, born on September 26, 1969, with junior high school education, a farmer. On April 18, 1990, he was sentenced to eight years' imprisonment for theft, and was released on May 5, 1996 after serving his sentence; on November 15, 1996, he was sentenced to nine years' imprisonment for the crime of raping a young girl, and was released on December 15, 2002 after serving his sentence; on January 28, 2005, he was sentenced to eight years' imprisonment for rape, and was released on November 12, 2011 after serving his sentence.

At approximately 5:00 a.m. on April 27, 2012, the defendant Yang Zongliang, in Haiyan County, Zhejiang Province, lured the victim Zhang (female, then aged 11), who was on her way to school, onto his truck, then, under the pretext of taking Zhang to school, deceived her into a mulberry field in Shendang Town, Haiyan County, and raped her.

At approximately 7:00 a.m. on May 23, 2012, the defendant Yang Zongliang, in Wanzhou District, Chongqing, falsely told the victim He (female, then aged 7), who was on her way to school, that He's mother had been in a car accident, thereby luring He into a shed on Tiancheng Avenue in Wanzhou District and raping her.

At approximately 7:00 a.m. on May 28, 2012, the defendant Yang Zongliang, in Wanzhou District, Chongqing, falsely claimed to be a primary school teacher to the victim Luo (female, then aged 9), who was on her way to school, and, under the pretext of asking Luo to help collect forms, lured Luo into an abandoned house on Taibai Subdistrict Office in Wanzhou District and raped her.

(2) Judgment

The court held that the defendant Yang Zongliang raped young girls under the age of 14, and his conduct constituted the crime of rape, for which he should be given a heavier punishment. Yang Zongliang raped multiple young girls, and had previously been sentenced to nine years' imprisonment for the crime of raping a young girl and eight years' imprisonment for rape, being a recidivist; within less than half a year after release, he again committed the crime of raping a young girl, showing deep subjective malignancy and great personal danger, and should be given a heavier punishment according to law. Given that Yang Zongliang truthfully confessed his crimes and had a good attitude of admitting guilt, the death penalty imposed on him need not be executed immediately, but restrictions on commutation of sentence should be imposed according to law. Accordingly, the defendant Yang Zongliang was found guilty of the crime of rape and sentenced to death, with a two-year reprieve and deprivation of political rights for life. Restrictions on commutation of sentence were imposed on the defendant Yang Zongliang.

Case 3: Guan Tianyi — Child Molestation Case

(1) Basic Facts

The defendant Guan Tianyi, male, Manchu ethnicity, born on December 6, 1986, with a bachelor's degree, a company employee.

In the afternoon of December 30, 2012, the defendant Guan Tianyi, under the pretext of testing the physical ability of the victim Wang (female, then aged 13), lured Wang to the top floor of a residential building in a certain residential area in Beijing and molested Wang.

In the afternoon of March 3, 2013, the defendant Guan Tianyi, under the pretext of testing the physical ability of the victim Ni (male, then aged 12), lured Ni to the 26th floor of a residential building in a certain residential area in Beijing and molested Ni.

In the afternoon of March 10, 2013, the defendant Guan Tianyi, under the pretext of testing the physical ability of the victim Gu (male, then aged 11), lured Gu to the 27th floor of a certain residential area in Beijing and molested Gu.

(2) Judgment

The court held that the defendant Guan Tianyi, for sexual gratification, molested one girl and two boys, and his conduct constituted the crime of child molestation. Guan Tianyi molested multiple children, and the circumstances were vile, warranting punishment according to law. Guan Tianyi expressed admission of guilt in court, and a discretionary lighter punishment may be imposed according to law. Accordingly, the defendant Guan Tianyi was found guilty of the crime of child molestation and sentenced to three years and six months' imprisonment.
